title: Best time many transactions
statementMd:
You may buy and sell many times (hold at most one share). Return the maximum total profit.

**Example:** `max_profit_multi([7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4])` returns `7`.
referenceSolution:
def max_profit_multi(prices):
    return sum(max(0, b - a) for a, b in zip(prices, prices[1:]))
